data.name: Module.optimize
data.value: Optimization

data.name: Optimize.game-dvr-off.Title
data.value: Turn off background game recording

data.name: Optimize.game-dvr-off.Explanation
data.value: Xbox Game Bar records the last minutes of play all the time, which slows games down. Screenshots still work.

data.name: Optimize.game-mode.Title
data.value: Turn on Game Mode

data.name: Optimize.game-mode.Explanation
data.value: Windows gives priority to the game you are playing.

data.name: Optimize.startup-delay-off.Title
data.value: Start your programs sooner

data.name: Optimize.startup-delay-off.Explanation
data.value: Removes the delay Windows adds before starting programs after you sign in.

data.name: Optimize.menu-delay.Title
data.value: Faster menus

data.name: Optimize.menu-delay.Explanation
data.value: Submenus open after 0.1 s instead of 0.4 s. Applies after you sign in again.

data.name: Optimize.transparency-off.Title
data.value: Turn off transparency effects

data.name: Optimize.transparency-off.Explanation
data.value: Saves a little graphics power and battery. The look becomes slightly plainer. May need you to sign in again.

data.name: Optimize.animations-off.Title
data.value: Turn off window animations

data.name: Optimize.animations-off.Explanation
data.value: Windows open and minimize instantly. Applies after you sign in again.

data.name: Optimize.fast-startup-off.Title
data.value: Turn off Fast Startup

data.name: Optimize.fast-startup-off.Explanation
data.value: Useful if updates or devices misbehave after a shutdown, or with dual boot. Startup becomes a few seconds slower.

data.name: Optimize.power-high.Title
data.value: High performance power plan

data.name: Optimize.power-high.Explanation
data.value: The processor stays at full speed. On a laptop, the battery drains faster.

data.name: Optimize.power-balanced.Title
data.value: Balanced power plan

data.name: Optimize.power-balanced.Explanation
data.value: The setting recommended by Windows: speed when needed, savings the rest of the time.

data.name: Optimize.hibernate-off.Title
data.value: Turn off hibernation

data.name: Optimize.hibernate-off.Explanation
data.value: Frees a file as large as your memory on the system disk. Also turns off Fast Startup. Keep it on a laptop.

data.name: Module.privacy
data.value: Privacy

data.name: Privacy.Title
data.value: Privacy

data.name: Privacy.Intro
data.value: Turn off Windows tracking, advertising and suggestions. Each change can be undone from History.

data.name: Privacy.Profile.recommended
data.value: Recommended

data.name: Privacy.Profile.strict
data.value: Strict

data.name: Privacy.telemetry-min.Title
data.value: Send Microsoft only the required diagnostic data

data.name: Privacy.telemetry-min.Explanation
data.value: Stops the "optional" data (browsing in Edge, app usage, typing…). Windows Update keeps working. Settings will show "managed by your organization", and Windows Insider builds need optional data.

data.name: Privacy.advertising-id-off.Title
data.value: Turn off the advertising ID

data.name: Privacy.advertising-id-off.Explanation
data.value: Apps can no longer use it to show you targeted ads.

data.name: Privacy.tailored-off.Title
data.value: Turn off tailored experiences

data.name: Privacy.tailored-off.Explanation
data.value: Microsoft stops using your diagnostic data for tips and offers.

data.name: Privacy.silent-apps-off.Title
data.value: Stop Windows from installing suggested apps by itself

data.name: Privacy.silent-apps-off.Explanation
data.value: Candy Crush, TikTok and other promoted apps are no longer added to the Start menu.

data.name: Privacy.suggestions-off.Title
data.value: Turn off tips and suggestions

data.name: Privacy.suggestions-off.Explanation
data.value: No more suggestions in Start, Settings and after updates ("Finish setting up your device").

data.name: Privacy.lockscreen-ads-off.Title
data.value: Turn off ads on the lock screen

data.name: Privacy.lockscreen-ads-off.Explanation
data.value: Removes the "fun facts" and offers shown over the lock screen picture.

data.name: Privacy.activity-history-off.Title
data.value: Turn off activity history

data.name: Privacy.activity-history-off.Explanation
data.value: Windows stops recording the files and sites you open.

data.name: Privacy.feedback-off.Title
data.value: Never ask for feedback

data.name: Privacy.feedback-off.Explanation
data.value: No more "How likely are you to recommend Windows?" pop-ups.

data.name: Privacy.typing-data-off.Title
data.value: Stop sending typing and handwriting data to Microsoft

data.name: Privacy.typing-data-off.Explanation
data.value: Stops "improving inking and typing" (data sent to Microsoft). Word suggestions on this PC keep working.

data.name: Privacy.recall-off.Title
data.value: Turn off Recall (screen snapshots)

data.name: Privacy.recall-off.Explanation
data.value: On Copilot+ PCs, Windows no longer takes regular snapshots of your screen.

data.name: Privacy.web-search-off.Title
data.value: No web results in Start search

data.name: Privacy.web-search-off.Explanation
data.value: Your searches are no longer sent to Bing: Start search only finds files, apps and settings. Also removes recent searches in File Explorer. Applies after signing in again.

data.name: Privacy.app-tracking-off.Title
data.value: Stop tracking app launches

data.name: Privacy.app-tracking-off.Explanation
data.value: The "Most used" list in Start disappears.

data.name: Privacy.location-off.Title
data.value: Turn off location for all apps

data.name: Privacy.location-off.Explanation
data.value: Weather, Maps, "Find my device" and the automatic time zone stop knowing where you are, for every account.

data.name: Privacy.error-reporting-off.Title
data.value: Turn off error reporting to Microsoft

data.name: Privacy.error-reporting-off.Explanation
data.value: Crash reports are no longer created or sent (Reliability Monitor shows fewer details). Microsoft can no longer offer you a fix for a known crash.
